title: Kylas Overlay settings
description: Pushed from the Google Admin console so BDs never enter anything. admin.google.com -> Devices -> Chrome -> Apps & Extensions -> Kylas Overlay -> Policy for extensions.

airtablePat.title: Airtable personal access token
airtablePat.description: Read-only token scoped to the company base. Set here, the token stays in the admin console and never ships inside the extension package.

airtableBaseId.title: Airtable base ID
airtableBaseId.description: Defaults to the company base if unset.

airtableTable.title: Airtable table name or ID
airtableTable.description: Defaults to the Company List table if unset.

airtableIdColumn.title: Kylas company ID column
airtableIdColumn.description: Defaults to "Kylas Company Id" if unset.

configUrl.title: Overlay config URL
configUrl.description: Raw URL of config/overlay-config.json in the meeting-booker repo. Only set this to point a team at a branch other than main.
